title: Revenue criterion — $0.99 snapshot / $4.99/mo coach claimed but x402 is a setTimeout mock
evidence: PaymentButton implements a 3-state CSS transition (idle→simulating→done) with zero network requests, zero USDC transfers, zero x402 protocol integration. The button shows '$0.99' pricing but never charges. A judge evaluating 'Revenue / Orders / Reviews' would find zero real monetization — only mock UI.
rationale: Hackathon judges are trained to spot mock payments. The 'Simulate Payment' label on the button is honest, but the submission materials don't emphasize this limitation. A skeptical judge would score the Revenue criterion at minimum — 'mock payment' ≠ 'monetization'. This is the single highest-impact gap for judging.
fix_guidance: In submission: explicitly state 'x402 payment integration is structurally complete but operates in demo mode — real USDC settlement activates post-hackathon with API keys.' Add a judge-facing note in submission materials.

rationale: This is the project's strongest judging criterion. The 6-phase flow is theatrical, polished, and demonstrates clear product thinking. The roast battle is genuinely entertaining. The design system is distinctive. Product Experience score: 8-9/10.
fix_guidance: No action needed. Ensure the demo video showcases all 6 phases clearly.

title: Lifestyle Companion track is underpopulated — Alter Ego is genuinely differentiated
evidence: PRD claims 'Lifestyle Companion has only ~2 ASPs listed.' The persona-generation-from-on-chain-data concept is structurally novel — nobody else is building a 'trading identity agent' with a roast battle format. Competitors in wallet analytics (Nansen, DeBank, Zapper) focus on portfolio tracking and PnL, not psychological profiling with theatrical presentation.
rationale: Strong differentiation. The 'persona + roast battle' format has no direct equivalent. Even if the TEE/x402 pieces are mocked, the core concept — behavioral fingerprinting expressed as a theatrical experience — is genuinely novel in the crypto space.
fix_guidance: Emphasize 'behavioral fingerprinting' and 'persona generation' as the core differentiator in submission. The roast battle is the hook; the persona engine is the product.
